cliHelpTitle: Control YT Music Player from the terminal. Commands:

cliHelpPlay: Play, pause, or switch between them
cliHelpNext: Skip to the next or the previous song
cliHelpSeek: Go to a time in the song, or forward or back by seconds

cliHelpDaemon: Start, stop or restart the background player

cliHelpVersion: Show the versions of ytm and the background player

cliDaemonNewerIncompatible: The background player ({daemon}) is newer than this ytm ({ours}) and doesn’t understand it. Update YT Music Player.
